title: Expedition Complete
text: The scouts sit by your Command Core with their backs to it, wrapped in thermal sheets, saying very little. One of them asks whether it's true that Marrow is still captain. When you say yes, she laughs until she cries.

choices.label: Return to Touchdown
choices.reply: The lander lifts. Below it the region keeps its own time, waiting.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: The Command Core's card lists every route, home included, when you're ready to go.

tags: act 2, engram, kindred, pip, expedition, travel
notes: onDone of pip-wreck. The Act 2 "Expedition complete" card: Return to Touchdown travels home; Stay keeps playing here (the Command Core lists every route).
